CANONICAL_NAME.value: hashicorp/memberlist 0.5.4 -- SWIM-style gossip membership and failure detection (the machinery under Consul, Nomad, Serf)

value.lineage: Das, Gupta, Motivala's SWIM (2002): scalable weakly-consistent membership by randomized probing (ping, ping-req through k peers, suspect, dead) with gossip dissemination -- the asynchronous, timeout-based failure detector that Serf (2013), Consul and Nomad run on. Lifeguard extensions (2018). Distinct assumptions from Raft: no leader, no log, eventual membership agreement, suspicion timeouts instead of quorum.

value.built_to: let every node in a cluster learn who is alive and who has died, without a coordinator, tolerating message loss and slow nodes
value.pressure: asynchronous network: lost probes, slow peers, partitions; false positives cost as much as misses
value.success_means: a dead node is declared dead within the suspicion timeout; a slow-but-alive node is refuted via indirect probes

value.failure_condition: a partition splits membership; a live node is wrongly declared dead and evicted
